method: The server states no limit: it accepts max_tokens 10,000,000 without refusing, and no read-only route (models, server_info, metrics, OpenAPI, tokenizer, KV cache events) names max_seq_len, max_num_tokens or a cache size. The declared maximum is therefore the largest output this endpoint was observed to complete: one streamed completion asked for exactly 65,536 tokens on a counting continuation that greedy decoding never ends by itself, and the server ended it with finish_reason length at exactly 65,536 completion tokens, with usage and [DONE].
observed: Before any probe the server answered metadata routes and a one-token chat in 0.44 seconds, so it was not held by the stalled request of September 23.
max_tokens 10,000,000 was accepted again without a refusal or a stated limit.
The tokenizer route returns only a count and token ids; the KV cache event route returns an empty list.
A completion requested at exactly 65,536 tokens ended with finish_reason length at 65,536 completion tokens after a 292-token prompt: 65,828 tokens in 467 seconds, about 140 a second.
The September 23 call 3, with the same 292-token prompt and max_tokens 10,000,000, streamed 105,574 tokens and then stalled with no stop reason, at 105,866 total tokens.
not_observed: The server's max_seq_len, max_input_len, max_num_tokens or KV cache size.
Any completed response longer than 65,536 output tokens.
decision: Declare 65,536 output tokens: measured, completed cleanly at the requested ceiling, and far enough below the observed stall that a generation prompt of several thousand tokens plus the full allowance stays under it. It is a verified maximum for this binding, not the server's stated limit; a larger value needs a new completed measurement or a stated limit and a successor record.
limitations: A longer prompt leaves the same output allowance only while prompt plus output stays below the stall point, which is not a stated limit either.
The measurement used the completions route; the generator uses the chat route of the same server and model.
